fields.description: Taken from the shard, which is where it is decided. Staging tenants are ours to break: the dev tooling may patch and redeploy the bench they sit on, and refuses any bench carrying a Production tenant.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Control-plane account for the workspace owner. Customer endpoints resolve the tenant from this, never from a parameter — that is what keeps one customer out of another's billing.
fields.label: Owner User

fields.description: Chosen at signup.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Fixed at signup; moving objects between jurisdictions later is a migration, not a setting.
fields.label: Storage Jurisdiction

fields.description: Permanent internal address. Never the custom domain.
fields.label: Site Name

fields.description: Customer-owned domain, once verified.
fields.label: Primary Domain

fields.description: ERPNext Customer. Created on first successful payment.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: What this workspace was signed up under, if anything. The answer to 'which of these are free demos'.
fields.label: Promo Code

fields.description: When this workspace stopped being paid for. Empty means it is not on the ladder.
fields.label: Dunning Started On

fields.description: Which rung the sweep last acted on. Distinct from status: an operator can suspend a paid-up workspace, and that is not the ladder.
fields.label: Dunning Stage

fields.description: Freeze this workspace out of the ladder entirely. A demo instance, a billing dispute, a legal hold. Nothing is suspended, archived or purged while this is set.
fields.label: Lifecycle Hold

fields.description: The date the cold copy and every object this workspace owns may be deleted. Set when it is archived.
fields.label: Purge After

fields.description: When the final warning went out. Purging refuses without one, so a bad window cannot delete a workspace that was never told.
fields.label: Purge Warned On

fields.description: R2 prefix holding the database, files and config this workspace can be rebuilt from.
fields.label: Cold Storage Key

fields.description: When it last came back from cold.
fields.label: Restored On

fields.description: When what it holds first exceeded what it is allowed. Enforcement bites after the overage grace window.
fields.label: Over Quota Since

fields.description: What it was holding at that moment, and the ceiling it may not grow past while the window is open. Taken then rather than at the first refused upload, which would ratchet upward every time one more file got through.
fields.label: Over Quota Bytes

fields.description: Reported by the site after each successful push to R2.
fields.label: Last Backup On

fields.description: Why the last attempt did not finish. A workspace that has not backed up in twice its interval is a fault, not a quiet gap.
fields.label: Last Backup Error

fields.description: Reported by the site. The resource that actually threatens the server, so it is capped like file storage.
fields.label: Database Used Bytes

fields.description: Extra file storage granted by an operator, on top of the plan and any add-ons. Never billed and never expires: this is the goodwill lever, not a product.
fields.label: Extra Storage GB

fields.description: Extra database granted by an operator, on top of the plan and any add-ons. Never billed and never expires: this is the goodwill lever, not a product.
fields.label: Extra Database GB

fields.description: Who else may sign in. Seats used is this plus the owner, and the plan's max_users is what caps it.
fields.label: Members

fields.description: Shared secret for signed calls with this tenant's site. Generated on creation.
fields.label: Hmac Secret
